# New Feature Depth

## User Persona
An inference investigator with the concrete constraint in the prompt.

## Scenario Coverage
Area: vllm-metal. Advanced/troubleshooting; route discovery, workflow depth and evidence boundary. Evidence-backed synthetic case, not an executed native model run.

## Expected Successful Behavior
- Uses named long-tail gaps and unsupported pairing boundaries.
- Does not infer joint support from feature presence or generic upstream interfaces.
- Proposes separately authorized bounded source/native research, not deployment.

## Failure Signals
Generic advice, source checkout dependency, unapproved mutations, unsupported pairing, hiding failed results or upgrading CPU/synthetic evidence to native PASS.
